s2.p2: Typed arrays have a fixed length and are used to store data in binary format (raw data).
s2.p3: Data in typed arrays can only be accessed through **views**, there is no direct access.
s2.p4: Binary data stored in a typed array can be interpreted as a string, as an audio or video file, as an image, or as an array of numbers.
s2.p5: The **TypedArray** constructor is also not directly available, and can be referenced from the inheritance chain of any instance.
